svg.text: BeliefLab | how much does feedback change the decision?
Every fixed action sequence is optimized. Same two-step model, rewards and discount.
the state indicated by its observation.
This is area, not a measured belief average.
b = probability of hidden state 0. Lines connect exact envelope breakpoints, not sampled beliefs.
Fixed sequences cannot condition later actions on observations. Both optima include all action costs.
Supplied finite model only. Not learned information value, a causal sensor experiment or real-world safety.
